scanNote: 42-betning o'ng chekkasi skanerda bir oz kesilgan: 10-mashq so'zlar ro'yxatining oxirgi so'zi ('hen') va sarlavhaning 'sentences' so'zi to'liq ko'rinmaydi. Ikkalasi ham matn mantig'i va bo'shliqlar soni (8 ta so'z — 8 ta bo'shliq) bo'yicha aniq tiklandi.

exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR — 40-betdagi matnlardan olingan.

ESLAB QOLING (bu birikmalar yodlanadi):
  feed somebody ON something — biror narsa bilan boqmoq
  weigh FROM ... TO ...       — ...dan ...gacha og'irlikda
  friendly TO somebody       — kimgadir do'stona
  live IN + joy (ichida)     — dengizda, guruhda, shaharda
  live ON + yuza             — muzda, orolda, yer yuzida
  live FOR + davomiylik      — ellik yil
  the ice OF Antarctica      — Antarktidaning muzi (egalik)

IN yoki ON?
  IN — ichida, o'rab turgan joy: in water, in seas, in groups
  ON — yuzasida: on the ice, on an island, on the grass

items.whyUz: 'feed somebody ON something' — o'zgarmas birikma. 'with' XATO.
'from ... to ...' — ...dan ...gacha. Ikkalasi birga ishlatiladi.
'friendly TO somebody' — kimgadir do'stona. 'friendly with' ham bor, lekin kitob 'to' beradi.
Dengiz suvining ichida yashaydi → IN.
'live FOR + davomiylik'. 'during' yoki 'in' XATO.
Muzning USTIDA → ON. 'the ice OF Antarctica' = Antarktidaning muzi.
'live IN groups' — guruh bo'lib yashamoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the animal noises and tick the animals you can hear. Which of them are wild animals and which are farm animals? Finally, write sentences as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Hayvon tovushlarini tinglang va eshitgan hayvonlaringizni belgilang. Ulardan qaysilari yovvoyi, qaysilari uy hayvoni? Nihoyat, namunadagidek gaplar yozing.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: QAYSI hayvon eshitilishi faqat kassetada aniqlanadi. Kitobda faqat 'a hen' belgilangan. Quyida YOVVOYI/UY hayvoni bo'linishi berilgan — bu qism audio talab qilmaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI GURUH:
  farm animals (uy/xo'jalik hayvonlari) — odam boqadi, fermada yashaydi
     a hen, a horse, a cow, a sheep
  wild animals (yovvoyi hayvonlar) — tabiatda o'zi yashaydi
     a crocodile, a monkey, a lion, a tiger,
     a parrot, a kangaroo, a snake, a penguin

KITOBDAGI NAMUNALAR:
  I can hear a hen. Hens are farm animals.
  I can't hear a crocodile. Crocodiles are wild animals.

DIQQAT — GAP TUZILISHI:
  1-gap BIRLIKDA:  I can hear A HEN.
  2-gap KO'PLIKDA: HENS ARE farm animals.

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. Tovuqni odam fermada boqadi.
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. Timsoh daryolarda o'zi yashaydi.
Otni odam boqadi va ishlatadi.
Maymun o'rmonda yashaydi.
Sher — Afrika savannasining yirtqichi.
Yo'lbars — o'rmon yirtqichi.
To'tiqushni uyda boqish mumkin, lekin tabiatda yovvoyi qush.
Kenguru Avstraliya tabiatida yashaydi.
Sigir sut beradi — asosiy xo'jalik hayvoni.
Ilon tabiatda o'zi yashaydi.
Qo'y jun va go'sht beradi. DIQQAT: 'sheep' ko'plikda ham 'sheep'.
Pingvin Antarktida muzida o'zi yashaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Finally, write sentences as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
Eshitgan hayvon uchun 'I can hear ...',
eshitmagani uchun 'I can't hear ...' deyiladi.
So'ng guruhi aytiladi.

example.speaker: Namuna 1
example.en: I can hear a hen. Hens are farm animals.
example.uz: Men tovuqni eshitayapman. Tovuqlar — uy hayvonlari.

example.speaker: Namuna 2

example.uz: Men timsohni eshitmayapman. Timsohlar — yovvoyi hayvonlar.

example.en: I can hear a cow. Cows are farm animals.
example.uz: Men sigirni eshitayapman. Sigirlar — uy hayvonlari.

example.uz: Men kenguruni eshitmayapman. Kengurular — yovvoyi hayvonlar.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text about koalas and underline the correct word.
exercises.instructionUz: Koalalar haqidagi matnni o'qing va to'g'ri so'zning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN (to'g'ri variantlar bilan):

  Koalas are MAMMALS and, like dolphins, they have babies and
  feed them on MILK. Mothers carry their young in a small pouch
  for the first six months of their lives. Koalas can CLIMB very
  well. They can swim very well, too. They have got thick, GREY
  fur and a big, black nose. They've also got very sharp CLAWS.
  Koalas live and sleep in the tops of eucalyptus trees in
  eastern AUSTRALIA. They live alone and eat eucalyptus leaves.
  Koalas live for about FIFTEEN years.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Koalalar — sutemizuvchilar va delfinlar kabi bola tug'adi hamda
  ularni sut bilan boqadi. Onalari bolasini birinchi olti oy
  davomida kichik xaltada olib yuradi. Koalalar juda yaxshi
  daraxtga chiqa oladi. Ular juda yaxshi suza ham oladi. Ularning
  qalin, kulrang juni va katta qora burni bor. Yana juda o'tkir
  tirnoqlari bor. Koalalar sharqiy Avstraliyadagi evkalipt
  daraxtlarining tepasida yashaydi va uxlaydi. Ular yolg'iz
  yashaydi va evkalipt bargini yeydi. Koalalar taxminan o'n besh
  yil yashaydi.

items.textEn: Koalas are 1) ............ and, like dolphins, they have babies.
items.uz: Bola tug'ib sut bilan boqadigan hayvon guruhi
items.whyUz: Bola tug'adi va sut bilan boqadi → sutemizuvchi. Baliq tuxum qo'yadi.

items.textEn: ... they have babies and feed them on 2) ............ .
items.whyUz: 'feed them on MILK' — sutemizuvchining asosiy belgisi.

items.uz: Koala daraxt tepasida yashaydi — u nima qila oladi?
items.whyUz: Koala — sutemizuvchi, qanoti yo'q, ucha olmaydi. Daraxtga CHIQADI (climb).

items.textEn: They have got thick, 4) ............ fur and a big, black nose.
items.whyUz: Rasmda koalaning juni kulrang. Burni esa qora — matnda alohida aytilgan.

items.uz: Daraxtga chiqish uchun kerak bo'ladigan o'tkir narsa
items.whyUz: 'sharp CLAWS' = o'tkir tirnoqlar. 'paws' (panjalar) o'tkir bo'lmaydi — tirnoq o'tkir bo'ladi.

items.textEn: Koalas live in the tops of eucalyptus trees in eastern 6) ............ .
items.uz: Koala va kenguru qaysi qit'ada yashaydi?
items.whyUz: Koala faqat Avstraliyada yashaydi. Evkalipt ham Avstraliya daraxti.

items.uz: Kichik hayvon uzoq yashamaydi — 15 mi, 50 mi?
items.whyUz:
Koala taxminan 15 yil yashaydi. 'fifty' (50) — delfinning umri.
TALAFFUZ: fifteen /fɪfˈtiːn/ oxirgi bo'g'inga urg'u; fifty /ˈfɪfti/ birinchi bo'g'inga.

exercises.explanationUz:
Javoblarni koalalar matnidan toping.
Javobni 'They' bilan boshlang.

items.answer: They can climb very well and they can swim very well, too.
items.whyUz: Matnda ikki qobiliyat: 'Koalas can climb very well. They can swim very well, too.'

items.answer: They have got thick, grey fur, a big, black nose and very sharp claws.
items.whyUz: 'What do they look like?' = ular qanday ko'rinadi? Tashqi ko'rinish tasvirlanadi.

items.answer: They live in the tops of eucalyptus trees in eastern Australia.
items.whyUz: Joy savoli. Matndan to'liq javob.

items.answer: They live for about fifteen years.
items.whyUz: 'How long' — davomiylik. 'live FOR' — 'for' shart.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the names of these animals and their young under the pictures. Then, make sentences as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlar tagiga bu hayvonlar va ularning bolalari nomini yozing. So'ng namunadagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ZLAR RO'YXATI:
  cat, chicks, dog, ducklings, duck, kittens, puppies, hen

HAYVON VA BOLASI — ALOHIDA SO'ZLAR:
  a cat  → kittens   (mushuk → mushukchalar)
  a hen  → chicks    (tovuq → jo'jalar)
  a dog  → puppies   (it → kuchukchalar)
  a duck → ducklings (o'rdak → o'rdakchalar)

DIQQAT: ingliz tilida bola hayvon uchun ALOHIDA so'z bor —
o'zbekchadagidek 'kichik mushuk' deyilmaydi.

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1 = cat, 2 = kittens.
NAMUNA GAP: A cat has kittens.

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN: ...cat...
Kitobda BERILGAN: ...kittens...
Rasmda katta urg'ochi uy qushi — 'a hen'. Erkagi 'a rooster' (41-betda ko'rgansiz).
'chicks' = jo'jalar. Doim ko'plikda ishlatiladi, chunki bir nechta bo'ladi.
Rasmda katta it — 'a dog'.
'puppies' = kuchukchalar. Birligi 'a puppy' (y → ies).
Rasmda o'rdak — 'a duck'. Keng, yassi tumshug'i bor.
'ducklings' = o'rdakchalar. 'duck' + -ling (kichraytiruvchi qo'shimcha).

exercises.instructionEn: Then, make sentences as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOLIP: A + hayvon + HAS + bolalari (ko'plikda).

DIQQAT: ega BIRLIKDA (a cat) → fe'l HAS.
'A cat HAVE kittens' XATO.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA: A cat has kittens.

exercises.instructionEn: First, read the statements and mark them as T (true) or F (false). Then, listen and check your answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval gaplarni o'qing va T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang. So'ng tinglab, javoblaringizni tekshiring.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kitobda ikki ustun bor: birinchisiga TAXMIN yoziladi, ikkinchisiga tinglagandan keyingi javob. Rasmiy javob kassetada. Quyidagi javoblar tabiiy faktlarga asoslangan va har biriga sabab keltirilgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
VIKTORINA — hayvonlar haqidagi qiziqarli faktlar.
Bu unit lug'ati (weigh, lay eggs, live for, groups) shu yerda takrorlanadi.

Birinchi javob kitobda BERILGAN: 1 = T.

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN javob: T. Ilonda tashqi quloq yo'q — u tebranishni jag' suyagi orqali sezadi.
TO'G'RI. Delfinlar taxminan 1–4 metr uzunlikda. 40-betdagi og'irligi (70–500 kg) ham shunga mos.
TO'G'RI. Ilon — sudralib yuruvchi, ko'pchiligi tuxum qo'yadi ('lay eggs' — 40-betdagi ibora).
TO'G'RI. Shimpanze taxminan 45–80 kilo keladi — odamga yaqin og'irlik.

items.sentence: 5  Lions sleep for 5 hours a day.
items.whyUz: NOTO'G'RI. Sher kuniga taxminan 20 SOAT uxlaydi — 5 emas. U juda kam harakat qiladi.

items.sentence: 6  Sea lions live in small groups.
items.whyUz: NOTO'G'RI. Dengiz sherlari KATTA guruhlarda (koloniyalarda) yashaydi — yuzlab hayvon birga.

NOTO'G'RI. Pingvin tuxumi OQ (yoki oqish yashil). Pingvinning O'ZI qora-oq, tuxumi emas.
DIQQAT: Penguins' — ko'plikdan keyin faqat apostrof.
NOTO'G'RI. Burgut JUDA YAXSHI ko'radi — odamdan bir necha barobar o'tkir. Shuning uchun u yuqoridan o'ljasini topadi.

items.sentence: 9  Elephants can live for about 60 years.
items.whyUz: TO'G'RI. Fil taxminan 60–70 yil yashaydi — quruqlikdagi eng uzoq yashovchi sutemizuvchilardan.

items.sentence: 10  Penguins can be under the water for 18 minutes.
items.whyUz: TO'G'RI. Pingvin suv ostida 18 daqiqagacha tura oladi. Shuning uchun u baliqni yaxshi tutadi.

wordFormation.introUz: 42-bet — bola hayvon nomlari va predlogli birikmalar.

groups.ruleUz: Hayvon va uning bolasi — ALOHIDA so'zlar
groups.explanationUz: Ingliz tilida ko'p hayvonning bolasi uchun butunlay boshqa so'z bor.
Bu birikmalarda predlog o'zgarmaydi — mantiq bilan topilmaydi.
Bu sonlar yozilishi ham, urg'usi ham boshqacha. Chalkashtirmang.
-s bilan tugagan ko'plikka egalik uchun faqat ' qo'yiladi.

patterns.formula: I can hear + a + hayvon. / I can't hear + a + hayvon.
patterns.exampleEn: I can hear a hen. I can't hear a crocodile.
patterns.exampleUz: Men tovuqni eshitayapman. Men timsohni eshitmayapman.
patterns.explanationUz: 'can' dan keyin fe'l asos shaklida. Hayvon BIRLIKDA, artikl bilan.

patterns.exampleEn: Hens are farm animals. Crocodiles are wild animals.
patterns.exampleUz: Tovuqlar — uy hayvonlari. Timsohlar — yovvoyi hayvonlar.

patterns.exampleEn: A cat has kittens. A duck has ducklings.
patterns.exampleUz: Mushukning mushukchalari bo'ladi. O'rdakning o'rdakchalari bo'ladi.
patterns.explanationUz: Birlik ega → HAS. Bolalar nomi ko'plikda, artiklsiz.

patterns.formula: What do they look like? — They have got + tashqi ko'rinish.
patterns.exampleEn: What do they look like? They have got thick, grey fur and a big, black nose.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular qanday ko'rinadi? Ularning qalin, kulrang juni va katta qora burni bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
'look like' = ...ga o'xshamoq, ...day ko'rinmoq.
DIQQAT: 'What do they like?' (nimani yoqtiradi?) — BUTUNLAY boshqa savol.

patterns.formula: Mothers carry their young IN a pouch FOR the first six months.
patterns.exampleEn: Mothers carry their young in a small pouch for the first six months of their lives.
patterns.exampleUz: Onalari bolasini birinchi olti oy davomida kichik xaltada olib yuradi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'young' bu yerda OT — 'bola, bolalari' (hayvonlar haqida).
'for + davomiylik' — necha vaqt davomida.

patterns.formula: They live alone and eat + ovqat.
patterns.exampleEn: They live alone and eat eucalyptus leaves.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular yolg'iz yashaydi va evkalipt bargini yeydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'alone' = yolg'iz. 'in groups' ning aksi.
'leaf' → ko'plikda 'leaves' (f → ves).
